summary: M2 framework-neutral core is implemented and its 28 unit tests, scoped payload/partner security gate, full repository build, and repository test suite pass. Bounded queues, fail-closed sanitization, partner-pure dispatch, failure containment, retry, kill switches, and bounded shutdown are ready for review; no Spring-specific auto-configuration is included.
nextActions: Review and accept the M2 public APIs, sanitizer policy, and dispatcher/drop semantics before beginning M3 Spring Boot integration.

Implement the downstream Alloy/Loki/Grafana security assertions in M4-M7 and the exact full-duration performance profiles in M9; whole-platform verify-all intentionally remains non-zero until those gates exist.
